about_art_credits: Cover art and backgrounds come from Steam, the Epic Games Store, GOG and — if you add your own API key — SteamGridDB. Gamut is not affiliated with any of them.
about_lib_pillow_desc: Loads and resizes profile icons and backgrounds.
about_lib_pyinstaller_desc: Packages this app into a standalone .exe.
about_lib_pystray_desc: Powers the system tray icon and status dot.
about_lib_python_desc: The language this app is written in.
about_lib_tkinter_desc: The UI toolkit used for every window and widget.
about_lic_free_commercial: Free for any use, including commercial
about_lic_gpl_bootloader: GPL-licensed bootloader; doesn't license your own script
about_license_disclaimer: License details are as commonly published by each project; check their official pages for the full, current text.
about_tagline: a manual play/pause game timer for gamers who want accurate playtime, notes, ratings, and genres, all easy to keep track of.
add_detect_hint: Pick it from what's running right now
add_no_apps: Nothing suitable is running right now
add_no_games_hint: No games detected. Start your game first, then reopen this — or pick it below if it's listed.
addtime_main_note: The main total always gets the full amount.
addtime_step2_question: Apply this change to which categories?
chk_enable_tray: Enable tray icon (shows a play badge while tracking)
complete_timer_picker_title: Which timer's time counts as the completion time?
confirm_clear_completion_msg:
Permanently delete {{name}}'s completion date and the playtime it was completed at?

This cannot be undone.
confirm_delete_msg: Delete '{{name}}' and its tracked time? This cannot be undone.
confirm_delete_note_msg: Delete the note '{{title}}'? This cannot be undone.
confirm_overwrite_drawing_msg: '{{title}}' already has a drawing. Replace it with this one?
confirm_overwrite_drawing_cross_game_msg: '{{title}}' in {{game}} already has a drawing. Replace it with this one?
confirm_stop_game_msg: Are you sure you want to close the game? Please save all your data first, or it might be lost.
confirm_reset_time_msg: Reset tracked time for '{{name}}' to zero?
dlg_add_time_desc: Log time played elsewhere, or remove time to correct a mistake — applied directly to this game's tracked total.
dlg_customize_colors_desc: Pick a color for each part of the UI
empty_no_games: No games yet — click + Add Game
err_add_time_empty: Enter an amount of time greater than zero.
err_open_exe_directory: Couldn't find that folder — it may have moved or been uninstalled.
err_already_running_msg:
Gamut is already open.
Check your system tray, or close the existing window before opening another.
err_missing_dep_bg_msg:
Custom backgrounds need Pillow.
Install with: pip install pillow
err_missing_dep_icons_msg:
Custom icons need Pillow.
Install with: pip install pillow
err_keybind_invalid: Combos need a modifier first (Shift, Ctrl, Alt or Tab), e.g. Ctrl+2. A 3-key combo must start Ctrl+Tab+…
err_keybind_register_failed: Couldn't register this combo — it may already be in use by another application.
hint_canvas: Right-click a game in the list for more options
hint_right_click: Right-click a game for more options
hint_stop_game_unstoppable: This game's anti-cheat runs it with elevated permissions Gamut can't act on — close it from the game itself.
installed_scan_folders_hint: Games kept somewhere else? Point Gamut at the folder that holds them.
installed_scan_hint: Reads your Steam library and offers anything not already here.
installed_scan_none: No installed games found. Gamut reads your Steam library — if Steam isn't installed, add games with + Add Game instead.
installed_scan_title: Add the games on this PC?
installed_scan_zero_note: Added games start at zero hours. Gamut only counts time it tracked itself — it can't know what you played before.
label_auto_start: Start timer automatically when a game launches
label_detail_level_hint: Applies to the Stats table and the More info window.
keybind_capture_hint: Click a combo, then press it — releasing any key finishes it
label_status_snapshot: Set on {{date}} — {{time}} played at the time.
label_steamgriddb_key_note: For fetching icons and backgrounds for non-Steam games from SteamGridDB. Optional — everything else works without it.
label_subcategories_enabled_hint: Lets a game's time be broken down into named categories (e.g. a completionist run vs. a casual replay). Off doesn't delete any category's tracked time — it only stops new sessions from asking which one to credit.
label_watch_games: Notice when a game starts or stops on its own
label_watch_games_hint: Checks every few seconds which games are running, even ones you started from Steam or a launcher instead of here. Needed for launch counts and for the timer to start or stop by itself.
launcher_paths_hint: Gamut finds these automatically. Set a folder only if your games are somewhere it doesn't look — it is searched as well as the usual places, never instead of them.
note_applies_on_save: Applies instantly when you hit Save.
note_choose_language: Choose your display language. Applies instantly when you hit Save.
note_font_timer:
Timer digits stay monospaced for alignment.
Applies instantly when you hit Save.
note_idle_explained: Time the game was running while the timer was not. Checked every few seconds, so on a very short session most of this is that check rather than real idle time.
note_idle_needs_watching: No idle time recorded. Idle time is the gap between how long the game was open and how long the timer ran, so it can only be measured while Gamut is watching for running games — turn on "Watch for games in the background" in Settings → General.
note_idle_none_yet: No idle time recorded yet. It appears once Gamut has seen this game open and close at least once.
note_eraser: Eraser — click a stroke to remove it
note_list_empty: No notes yet — click + New note to add one.
note_move_to_hint: Move this drawing to a different note
note_drag_back_hint: Drag it back onto this box to reattach
note_open_elsewhere: Drawing open in a separate window
note_pop_out_busy: Close the other pop-out to move it here
note_select_genres: Click to select any number of genres.
note_startup_exe_only: Only works from the built .exe, not the .py script
note_tray_behavior:
When enabled, closing the window (X) hides it to the tray
instead of quitting. Use 'Quit' in the tray's right-click menu to exit fully.
profile_stats_empty: No games tracked yet — Profile Stats fills in once you've played something.
profile_stats_no_genre_data: No genre data yet — tag a game's genres to see it here.
subcat_delete_confirm: Delete "{{name}}"? Its {{time}} of tracked time is deleted too — this cannot be undone.
subcat_prompt_title: Which category is this session for, {{name}}?
toast_screenshot_fallback: Captured the full screen — couldn't isolate {{name}}'s window
warn_already_exists_msg: A profile with that name already exists.
